name: Plugin Shelf
summary: Pin Decky plugins to Steam's menu or their own Quick Access tab, and group Decky's list into folders.
description:
Pin any installed Decky plugin:
• as its own Quick Access tab, next to Decky's, or
• in the main Steam menu (it opens as a full-screen page).

Group Decky's plugin list into folders, so a long list stays short. A Plugin Shelf Tome on your Desk opens your pinned plugins and folders too.

This changes Decky's own menus, so a Decky update can break it. It starts turned off; turn it on in Scrolls. If it can't find Decky's parts, it turns itself off and says why.
author: MarshyMadness
